{{Quote|Thank you, Obi-Wan! I have much to tell you about these thugs. They are receiving large shipments of arms and plan on turning Coruscant into a war zone.|The [[Unidentified Quarren informant|informant]] to Kenobi|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was involved in a series of '''skirmishes''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Black Heth]] gang joined with the [[Jin'ha]] warriors to start a war on the planet, but Kenobi undertook several missions to stop them. He fought a [[Black Heth]] [[Unidentified Trandoshan (Black Heth)|gang leader]] at an [[Elcor Station]], rescued an [[Unidentified Quarren informant|informant]], and planted a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] on an arms dealer's [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The tracking device led the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to launch an [[First mission to Obredaan|investigative mission]] to [[Obredaan]].

==Prelude==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was bloated with corruption. Following the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] of that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ascended to the post of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the non-[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] members of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] faced charges of corruption. The events were secretly directed by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="Cloak" /> and [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], heirs to the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith legacy]].<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

Later, on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the seat of Republic power,<ref name="Cloak" /> suspicious reports were reaching the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="OW guide">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] personally assigned [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to investigate the dangerous new [[Black Heth]] criminal gang.<ref name="SW:OW crawl">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] opening crawl</ref>

The [[Summertime War]] was waging on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="Shatter" /> while on the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] started her rule after her predecessor [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] abdicated the throne.<ref name="NEC" />

==The skirmishes==
===Underworld===
[[File:JinhaVsKenobi-ObiWan.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] fighting a [[Jin'ha]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
Kenobi was patrolling in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], and when returning to the [[Elcor Station]], became involved in a fight with the Black Heth, who had taken over the station. Kenobi cleared the wreckage blocking the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and defeated a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Unidentified Trandoshan (Black Heth)|gang member]]. Kenobi felt something sinister in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] regarding the attack.<ref name="SW:OW" />

Kenobi then returned to the Temple and was briefed before the Jedi Council in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]]. Windu mentioned that the Black Heth had only been involved in petty crime before that point, and that the escalation was a matter of concern. Kenobi then reported his concerns as well, and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] told him to prepare. Kenobi then dueled with a [[Jedi training droid/Legends|Jedi Training Droid]] before his assignment to the next mission.<ref name="SW:OW" />

===Informant===
Kenobi was then assigned to rescue a<ref name="SW:OW" /> [[Senate Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]<ref name="ObiwanGuard" /> [[Unidentified Quarren informant|informant]] who had been captured by the Black Heth. Kenobi infiltrated the construction site they were holding the informant, and avoided detection by dispatching the gang members and droids who attempted to sound the alarm. Kenobi was able to free the informant, who warned him the Black Heth was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] weapons to turn Coruscant into a warzone.<ref name="SW:OW" />

===Secrets===
Black Heth were buying weapons from an unknown organization and were making a pickup on [[landing platform Nilat-3]]. Kenobi was assigned to discover the identity of the organization. Kenobi [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on the platform with [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] until a [[Jin'ha starship|starship]] arrived. He reported the arrival to his Master, who ordered him to plant a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]]. Kenobi was then spotted by the Black Heth and forced to defend himself.<ref name="SW:OW" />

Additional gang members arrived, but Kenobi was able to dispatch them. He then fought several trained warriors, but defeated them and planted the tracking device.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Aftermath==
The tracking device led to the planet [[Obredaan]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent a team to [[First mission to Obredaan|investigate]] the [[Jin'ha]] warriors, which failed, necessitating a [[second mission to Obredaan]]. Following the announcement of the first mission, Kenobi had a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|training duel]] with Council member [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]].<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmishes on Coruscant appears in the first chapter of the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. During the mission to rescue the informant, if the player allows an alarm to be triggered, the Black Heth gang executes the informant.
